Both are already linked to 229 common concepts, including stability result, eigenfunction and american style option, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses stability result as a bridge: first, review how stopping time and vanilla option are each currently treated through stability result; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.

Both are already linked to 218 common concepts, including leading term, particle system and european contingent claim, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses leading term as a bridge: first, review how jump process and log price are each currently treated through leading term; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.

We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
